classification.difficultyReason: Interpret the annual income as one year's interest, set T = 1 and solve for the invested principal before rounding money.

content.prompt: Tyler intends to live on the interest on an investment with the bank at $8.6\%$ p.a. simple interest. She will receive $\$68\,000$ simple interest every year from the investment. How much money has she invested? Give your answer to the nearest cent.

answer.worked:
For one year's interest, $T=1$.

$$\begin{aligned}I&=PRT\\68\,000&=P\times0.086\times1\\68\,000&=0.086P\\P&=\frac{68\,000}{0.086}\\P&\approx\$790\,697.67\end{aligned}$$
Tyler has invested $\$790\,697.67$, to the nearest cent.
